description.text: The Totodile deck from Intro Pack neo, a Japanese two-player practice set for newcomers from the Gold and Silver era. The box held a Chikorita deck and a Totodile deck of 40 cards plus a holo card each, 30 damage counters, two poison markers, a paper practice playmat, a pink Chansey coin and a rule book, so it could be played straight away. This deck's holo is Feraligatr by Ken Sugimori, marked with a Totodile symbol, and several of the box's cards have artwork not printed anywhere else.
